description:
Four plan-text and coverage findings from the AS-42 cycle-1 QA review (qa-priya, 2026-09-02; verdict PASS 28/28, none blocked the merge). AS-42 merged at 7b8ef2d. Three are corrections to AS-42's own plan, which is board state on master and the tech lead's to edit; one is a real coverage gap that needs a test.

1. COVERAGE GAP, and the only item here that needs code. No falsification recipe in AS-42 section 7 falsifies the ownership scoping at all. The reviewer found this because a case passed under one mutant for a reason unrelated to ownership, then closed the gap out of band: she bypassed route, service AND repository and issued a raw INSERT with a mismatched (freelancer_id, client_id) pair. SQLite refused it with FOREIGN KEY constraint failed and zero rows written — so the composite foreign key genuinely is the bottom layer. But no committed test reaches it, which means the layer the design leans on hardest is the one nothing in the suite exercises. Add a recipe that breaks ownership scoping and a case that fails without the composite FK, shown red once per the house technique.

2. PLAN SECTION 7 RECIPE M7 GIVES A FALSE GREEN AS WRITTEN. Its literal mutation reddens a test at the wrong assertion — the sufficient case rather than the necessary one — so following the plan verbatim produces a green that means nothing. The implementer substituted a different value and it worked; the reviewer's finding is that the substitution was NECESSARY rather than cosmetic, which the implementation report understated. Correct the recipe.

3. PLAN SECTION 7 RECIPE M12 IS MIS-AIMED, and worse than reported. Its literal form kills twelve test files at import (369 cases down to 138), so the probe is unevaluable rather than merely mis-predicted; the runnable form leaves its target cases green because they quantify over the exported declaration, not the registry the probe mutates. The reviewer built a working substitute — a fifth valid declared variable and slot — which reddens four cases and DEMONSTRATES the property the recipe only argued. Replace M12 with the substitute.

4. PLAN SECTION 7 RECIPE M1's predicted set is wrong for the mutation it describes, and section 3.5's illustrative sample shows an unescaped value against the rule stated three lines above it. The rule governs and the shipped bytes are correct; the sample is what a screen author would copy. Fix both.

ALSO RECORDED, not work for this task: a request carrying a prototype-pollution key returns 303 rather than 400, because the body parser strips the key one layer above the application — req.body never carries it, prototypes were verified intact, and every other spelling returns 400. Intent is met, the stated wording is not, and the behaviour is app-wide rather than AS-42's. If it is ever worth pinning, it belongs to whichever task owns the parser configuration.

ACCEPTANCE: item 1 has a test that fails without the composite foreign key, and a recipe that breaks ownership scoping, both shown red once (assert the mutation applied on disk and in the built image with occurrence-accurate counts, predict executable case names that exist, restore, prove restoration by content hash plus git status --porcelain, rebuild before re-running). Items 2 through 4 are plan text and need no test. Suite stays green; no new dependencies; no migration; no protected top-level file edited; no running container touched. Complexity low.
title: AS-42 residuals: ownership has no falsifier, and three section-7 recipes are wrong as written
